items.title: 阿曼｜Al Dhahirah经济区二期道路与公用设施工程招标
items.title_en: Oman | Al Dhahirah Economic Zone IP2 roads and utilities tender
items.summary: OPAZ在Al Dhahirah经济区IP2发布道路及公用设施工程招标，涉及道路、供排水、公共管网和基础设施配套，编号15/2026/OPAZ，所列截标日2026年10月18日。
items.summary_en: OPAZ tendered roads and utility networks for Al Dhahirah Economic Zone IP2, tender 15/2026/OPAZ, with a reported deadline of 18 October 2026.
items.why_it_matters: 截标日在晨报当天，能否投标需向采购方确认延长或接收状态。
items.why_it_matters_en: The reported deadline falls on the briefing date; bidders must verify whether submission remains possible.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注道路材料、土建、供水管网、电缆及施工设备。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track civil works, road materials, water utilities, cables and machinery.

items.title: 葡萄牙｜Sines铁路第三阶段工程约1650万欧元招标
items.title_en: Portugal | Sines railway Phase 3 works tender worth €16.5m
items.summary: 葡萄牙基础设施公司发布Sines铁路第三阶段工程采购，估算1650万欧元、工期540天，欧盟公告编号715241-2026，所列截止日期11月12日。
items.summary_en: A tender for Sines railway Phase 3 works carries an estimated €16.5m value and 540-day period, EU notice 715241-2026, with a reported 12 November deadline.
items.why_it_matters: 为港口铁路运输连接提供土建和材料采购机会。
items.why_it_matters_en: Port rail connectivity works may create civil engineering and supply opportunities.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注铁路土建、轨道材料、施工设备和葡萄牙本地承包商。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track rail civil works, track materials, machinery and local contractors.

items.title: 西班牙｜Las Palmas港海事工程约4532万欧元招标
items.title_en: Spain | Las Palmas maritime works tender estimated €45.32m
items.summary: Las Palmas港务局为Muelle Adosado Reina Sofía Sur海事工程发布采购，估算4532万欧元，编号I-2025/12，公告截止日10月28日。
items.summary_en: Las Palmas Port Authority published the Muelle Adosado Reina Sofía Sur maritime works tender, valued around €45.32m, ref I-2025/12, with a 28 October deadline.
items.why_it_matters: 明确海事施工项目，需核实投标资格和技术要求。
items.why_it_matters_en: A defined marine works package requiring eligibility and technical specification checks.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注港口土建、钢结构、混凝土、海工设备及专业分包。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track marine civil works, steel, concrete, equipment and specialist subcontractors.

items.title: 摩洛哥｜Mohammed V机场新航站楼制冷系统采购
items.title_en: Morocco | Mohammed V Airport new terminal cooling systems procurement
items.summary: 卡萨布兰卡Mohammed V机场新航站楼据采购汇总发布制冷能源生产、输配及安装采购信息，所列截标日11月26日。该包与此前机场登机桥等采购包不同，原始招标文件需核对。
items.summary_en: A procurement listing indicates cooling energy production, distribution and installation for the Casablanca Mohammed V Airport new terminal, reported closing 26 November; verify the primary tender documents.
items.why_it_matters: 新航站楼机电专业采购具有潜在设备供应机会。
items.why_it_matters_en: Specialist terminal HVAC procurement could open a supplier route.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注冷水机组、水泵、阀门、管道、楼宇自控及机场机电。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track chillers, pumps, valves, piping, controls and airport MEP.

items.title: 摩洛哥｜Ghanem变电站向区域变电站增供电工程采购
items.title_en: Morocco | Ghanem substation power reinforcement procurement
items.summary: 据采购汇总，从225/60/22kV Ghanem变电站向60/22kV RADEEJ I和III变电站增供电力项目正在采购，所列截止日期11月17日；需以采购方原始文件为准。
items.summary_en: Procurement listings report grid reinforcement from the 225/60/22kV Ghanem substation to 60/22kV RADEEJ I and III substations, with a stated 17 November deadline subject to official verification.
items.why_it_matters: 输配电升级可能带来设备和安装需求。
items.why_it_matters_en: Grid upgrades may require specialist equipment and installation.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注电力电缆、开关设备、变压器、保护系统及输配电承包。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track cables, switchgear, transformers, protection and power contracting.

items.title: 莫桑比克｜Machubo多用途供水系统土建工程采购
items.title_en: Mozambique | Machubo multipurpose water supply civil works tender
items.summary: 据采购公告汇总，Machubo地区韧性多用途供水系统土建工程正在采购，所列截止日期11月2日，预算与详细范围待官方文件确认。
items.summary_en: Procurement listings indicate civil works for the Machubo resilient multipurpose water supply system, with a reported 2 November deadline; scope and budget require original tender confirmation.
items.why_it_matters: 乡村水务设施有明确的潜在设备和工程交付需求。
items.why_it_matters_en: Rural water infrastructure can provide civil works and equipment supply opportunities.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注水泵、管道、储水设备、供电和水务施工。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track pumps, pipes, storage, power systems and waterworks construction.

items.title: 巴西｜Galeão机场拟吸引约10亿雷亚尔商业设施投资
items.title_en: Brazil | Galeão Airport targets R$1bn commercial facilities investment
items.summary: Galeão机场公布未来三年拟引入约10亿雷亚尔商业设施投资，包括酒店、车辆测试设施、飞机维修机库和物流仓储等；目前是投资规划而非已授出建设合同。
items.summary_en: Galeão Airport outlined plans to attract around R$1bn in commercial developments over three years, including a hotel, vehicle testing facility, MRO hangar and warehouses; this is a plan, not awarded works.
items.why_it_matters: 机场周边产业建设可能形成中期供货和工程机会。
items.why_it_matters_en: Airport-related commercial development may generate future supply and works opportunities.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注工业建筑、机库设备、酒店装修、仓储自动化及机电。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track industrial construction, hangars, hotel fit-out, warehouse automation and MEP.
items.source_name: Brazil Ministry of Ports and Airports
